// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-UNPROJECTED-READ
// A permitted method on a permitted model, and it returns fifty password
// hashes, because a Prisma read with no select: returns every scalar column.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function allTeachers() {
  return db.teacher.findMany({ take: 50 });
}
